meta.name: add-ollama-tool
meta.description: Add Ollama MCP server so the container agent can call local models and optionally manage the Ollama model library.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加本地 Ollama 服务，容器代理可直接调用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你的容器代理需要调用本地 Ollama 模型，又不想手动折腾配置
copy.tagline_en: Connect your container agent to local Ollama models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your container agent needs to call local Ollama models and you'd prefer a straightforward setup

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 仍是主导者，但可以把任务转交给本机 Ollama 模型。它能列出已安装模型、向指定模型发提示并返回结果；开启管理工具后还能下载、删除、查看模型详情和列出已加载模型。
howto.when: 当你明确要求用 Ollama 模型来回答或做本地推理时触发；开启管理工具后，也可在要求下载、删除模型等模型库操作时触发。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude still orchestrates but can offload tasks to local Ollama models on the host. It can list installed models and send prompts to a chosen one; with admin tools on, it can also pull, delete, show, and list loaded models.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for an Ollama model to answer or run local inference; with admin tools enabled, also when you ask to pull or delete models and similar library operations.

say_en.text: Use ollama to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: Claude first calls ollama_list_models, then ollama_generate.

say_en.text: Which ollama models are currently loaded in memory?
